subject: Post-call recap — identify spend owner & legal/procurement next steps
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Moreno <alicia@clearlytics.com>, Ben Liao <ben.liao@clearlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 14:32:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap — identify spend owner & legal/procurement next steps

Hi Alicia / Ben —

Thanks again for the 30-min sync earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

1) Economic/budget owner: you mentioned finance may sign off (Ben?) — can you confirm the single person who will own the budget and approval? If that’s Ben, would you introduce us on an internal thread so we can align timelines and cost expectations.

2) Security / legal gate: you noted a short security review + standard TPRM. I’ve attached our SOC2 summary and one-pager to speed the review, but please tell us if you need a full report or an attestation.

3) Procurement / SOW: procurement wants a one-page scope + estimated monthly run-rate to draft the SOW. If you share target term and volume we’ll sketch a draft SOW and a mutual action plan.

Attachments: redwood-onepager.pdf (attached)

Proposed next small steps (feel free to edit):
- Ben (or designated budget owner) intro to align on budget window and approvals
- Procurement contact to share their SOW template / timeline
- 30-min kickoff with procurement + legal next week to walk the mutual action plan

I’ll keep this thread and loop Marissa to own the mutual action plan and Sean on pricing/discount options once the budget owner is confirmed.

Thanks — looking forward to continuing.

--
Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Alicia Moreno <alicia@clearlytics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Liao <ben.liao@clearlytics.com>, procurement@clearlytics.com, legal@clearlytics.com
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — identify spend owner & legal/procurement next steps

Kimberly —

Great summary, thanks. A few quick confirmations from my side: 

- Economic/budget owner: Ben Liao (CFO) will be the final approver for any pilot spend > $50k. I’ve copied Ben and Procurement (procurement@clearlytics.com).

- Procurement: please use the attached procurement template (I’m attaching our internal template for reference). Our procurement lead (copied) would like a one-page SOW + estimated monthly spend to start drafting paperwork. Target timeline is 2–3 weeks for initial procurement review.

- Security/legal: Legal asked for a SOC2 attestation (or the SOC2 report) and a short answers-based TPRM questionnaire. If you can provide the SOC2 report and a one-page security summary that will speed things up.

I’ve attached our procurement template (clearlytics-procurement-template.pdf) for your procurement team. I’ll leave it to Ben and Procurement to suggest a time for the kickoff.

Thanks — can we aim to have draft SOW + security pack over to procurement by early next week?

Best,
Alicia
Director of Product Partnerships | Clearlytics
alicia@clearlytics.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Moreno <alicia@clearlytics.com>, Ben Liao <ben.liao@clearlytics.com>, procurement@clearlytics.com
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 16:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — identify spend owner & legal/procurement next steps

Hi Alicia / Ben / procurement team —

Thanks for the quick replies and for attaching the procurement template. I’ll lead the mutual action plan (MAP) and stitch together a concise SOW and timeline for your procurement review. Plan below: 

- By Mon 6/4: Redwood to send a one-page SOW + estimated run-rate for a 3-month pilot (includes expected token volumes and an estimated committed capacity).
- By Tue 6/5: Redwood to share SOC2 attestation and a one-page security summary (SOC2 report available on request & DPA language included).
- By Wed 6/6: 30-min kickoff with procurement + legal to walk the SOW + MAP and capture redlines. Please propose 2 windows that work for procurement/legal.

Sean — can you confirm the commercial ranges we should propose for a pilot to stay within Ben’s $50k threshold (or if we should propose a phased approach)?

Alicia / Ben — if you’re comfortable, Ben can confirm the formal approver so we know who needs to sign the purchase order.

Thanks — I’ll upload the MAP to the shared Drive link and update the HubSpot record once items are posted.

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Strategic Account Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Moreno <alicia@clearlytics.com>, Ben Liao <ben.liao@clearlytics.com>, procurement@clearlytics.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 18:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — identify spend owner & legal/procurement next steps

Alicia / Ben —

Thanks for looping us in. Quick note to confirm I’ll own the commercial proposal and provide a pilot option that stays under the $50k threshold: 

- I’ll prepare two pilot pricing options: (A) 3-month committed pilot scoped to expected QPS/volume that targets $45k total; (B) Phased pilot starting at $15k/mo with a clear ramp schedule and checkpoints.
- I’ll also attach a draft SOW and a short pricing appendix that maps to the mutual action plan.

Forwarding Kimberly’s original note below for context.
